1: Beshak Allah ne aap ke liye aap ka seena khol diya aur wahi ka milna aap ko mehboob bana diya.
2: Aur maine aap se bojh utaar diya,
3: woh bojh jo aap par itna bhaari tha ke qareeb tha ke aap ki peeth tor de.
4: Aur maine aap ke liye aap ka zikr buland kiya, pas ab aap ko azaan mein, iqamat mein aur doosre mauqon par yaad kiya jata hai.
5: Beshak mushkil aur tangi ke saath aasani aur kushadgi hai.
6: Beshak mushkil aur tangi ke saath aasani aur kushadgi hai; jab aap yeh khoob jaan lein, to aap ki qaum ka sataana aap ko hayran na karega aur Allah ki taraf bulane se na rokega.
7: Pas jab aap apna kaam khatam kar lein aur usey poora kar lein, to apne Rubb ki ibadat mein koshish kijiye.
8: Aur apni raghbat aur irada sirf Allah hi ki taraf pheriye.
